mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals an impending recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the unemployment rate, defined as an increase of > 0.5pp in one month, signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE spikes > 0.5pp in 1 month but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by an inverted yield curve.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in consumer sentiment, proxied by a > 5% monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS), signals a rapid deterioration in consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 5% in 1 month but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 60 for two consecutive months, it signals a strengthening economy that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by falling unemployment.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 60 for 2 months and UNRATE falling, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate, defined as a drop of > 0.5pp over 3 months, signals an improving labor market and strengthening consumer demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in inflation, proxied by a > 0.5% monthly increase in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL), signals rising input costs and consumer price pressures that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising interest rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS rising, but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
